range_decision.evidence: A temporary observation offset is identified starting at index 489. The East (E) component exhibits a sharp, sustained positive step of approximately 6 MAD units relative to the preceding trend. This elevated level persists across multiple samples until an opposing return occurs around index 591, where the E component drops back to its previous baseline. The North (N) and Up (U) components do not show corresponding steps, confirming this as a single-axis temporary offset rather than physical motion.
